# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle is already waiting. Not against flesh and blood, but against complacency, distraction, and the quiet pull to drift through the day instead of engaging it. Joshua stood at the edge of the promised land with an impossible mission ahead—and God didn't tell him to feel brave. He commanded him to be brave. Courage is not the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of it. Notice the anchor: "the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." You are not asked to manufacture strength on your own. You are asked to show up, trust the One who goes before you, and act. Men of God don't wait for perfect conditions—they rise, armor up in prayer, and step into the fight. Where is God calling you to be strong today? A hard conversation, a discipline you've been avoiding, a temptation you've been entertaining? The command stands. Be strong. Be courageous. He is with you.
## Daily Challenge
Before your first task today, do 20 pushups and pray: "Lord, make me strong and courageous for Your glory." Then take one bold step you've been putting off.
